title: Digital GreenTalents Award

provider.name: Federal Ministry of Education and Research

summary: Annual award for 20 young scientists worldwide combining digital technology and sustainability, funding a 1- to 3-month research stay in Germany and a mentoring programme.

degree_levels.notes: PhD students and students in the final year of a Master's degree.

subject_areas.notes: Research topics combining digital technology and sustainability.

institutions.notes: Research institution or company in Germany.

nationality.notes: Applicants from around the world (listed in the source's country selection).

mandatory.text: current enrolment in a PhD programme or the final year of a Master's programme

exceptions.text: Time spent on childcare, etc. can be taken into account for the age limit.

funding.description: Fully-funded 1- to 3-month research stay in Germany, accompanying mentoring programme, and participation in the Digital GreenTalent SummerSchool.

application_rounds.notes: Application periods will be published on the website.

recurring_deadline_notes: Annually, periods published on the website.

required_documents.text: proof of current enrolment in a Master's or doctoral programme (if currently studying) or proof of PhD degree (if just completed)
English language proficiency certificate (for non-native speakers)

steps.text: Conduct application online through the Digital GreenTalents website using the online tool LimeSurvey.
Upload all required documents as PDF files.
Upload application video as described on the website.
Answer motivation questions (max. 500 words) during online application.

sources.title: Federal Ministry of Education and Research: Digital GreenTalents Award - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The award funds a research stay in Germany for international PhD students and final-year Master's students.
